v1.13.0 release (2026-04-23) hit a transient "Error creating policy" from GitHub's storage API on softprops/action-gh-release v3.0.0 → release stuck in DRAFT with 3/4 artifacts; manual recovery. Debug-tag rerun under #96 could NOT reproduce — looks transient, not deterministic.

CURRENT POSTURE (PR #98): re-pinned to @v3.0.0 with continue-on-error attempt 1 + `if: outcome == 'failure'` retry. v3 defaults overwrite_files:true, so the retry idempotently completes partial releases.

IF IT RECURS: retry caught it → transient, move on. Retry ALSO fails → there's a real determinant (size? MIME? parallelism?) — re-enable debug secrets, push a throwaway debug tag, capture the full API response body. Don't file upstream without a deterministic repro.
